% Checks cases that the fix of test-fvcolor-listings must not break: the
% color package in the preamble, where tex4ht configures color, and
% listings.4ht still loads xcolor after the preamble. fancyvrb's colors
% are drawn.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{color}
\usepackage{fancyvrb}
\usepackage{listings}
\VerbatimFootnotes
\DefineVerbatimEnvironment{FvCode}{Verbatim}{frame=lines}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\input{test-fvcolor-cases.ltx}
A listing: \lstinline|fv-lstinline|.
\begin{Verbatim}[formatcom=\color{red}]
fv-red
\end{Verbatim}
\end{document}
